text:
leah: quick sync — ACME pilot launch criteria + deps. we need to lock sequencing today.
raj: outline of top blockers from runtime: quant model variant not tested at scale, KV cache hotpath needs perf numbers.
carmen: infra blockers: prewarm slots, dedicated pool sizing, netpol for customer VPC. need answers by EOD.
sam: security: HSM keywrap + audit trail mandatory for pilot. HSM vendor onboarding still pending.
derek: SRE: can handle staged rollout but want canary + automatic fallback to hosted model on capacity breach. need runbook.
leah: proposed launch gates: (1) perf: P95 gen <250ms for 90% of traffic in canary; (2) security: HSM + KMS audit enabled; (3) infra: prewarm + 2 dedicated nodes reserved; (4) runtime: quantized model + KV cache warmed.
raj: for runtime can do q4_8bit variant but we'll need throughput benchmarks. I'll aim to run a 6h soak on canary config tomorrow.
carmen: reserving 2xA100 for pilot window — need a firm ttl and start time. @leah when is the customer window?
leah: customer window: 2026-04-08 to 2026-04-15. reserve starting 04-07 00:00 UTC through 04-16.
sam: HSM onboarding ETA? we have vendor ticket #5421 but still waiting for SOC docs. security cannot sign off without attestation.
derek: runbook stub: steps for fallback. suggest: healthcheck -> if p95 > 350ms for 5m -> switch to hosted fallback. we can automate via routing policy.
raj: noted. runtime action items: (a) perf soak + measurements (owner: raj, due: 04-02), (b) KV cache prewarm script and metrics (owner: raj, due: 04-04), (c) provide compatible model variant id for fallback (owner: raj, due: 04-03).
carmen: infra action items: (a) reserve 2xA100 in dedicated pool (owner: carmen, due: 03-31), (b) netpol + VPC peering + IP allowlist (owner: carmen, due: 04-05), (c) prewarm allocator + telemetry hook (owner: carmen/derek, due: 04-06).
sam: security action items: (a) HSM attestation docs and keyflow diagram (owner: sam, due: 03-30), (b) KMS integration test in staging (owner: sam + carmen, due: 04-05).
leah: product/acceptance items: (a) canonical prompt set for quality checks (owner: leah, due: 03-29), (b) rollout criteria doc + rollback thresholds (owner: leah/derek, due: 04-01).
derek: I'll draft the automated fallback policy and the escalation page. also want an on-call rotation for pilot period.
leah: small ask: can we get perf baseline numbers for hosted fallback so we can compare? @raj can you attach 95/99 numbers to the soak report.
raj: will include p50/p95/p99 and token-cost deltas vs quantized run.
carmen: one risk: prewarm may spike infra cost badly if cache is big. propose soft prewarm first (10% of expected qps).
sam: security note: no production keys should be in staging. use test HSM for integration.
leah: decision checkpoint: we will proceed with pilot if runtime soak shows P95 <= 250ms and HSM attestation is present. otherwise postpone one week.
raj: ack. starting soak tomorrow morning.
carmen: will submit reservation ticket now.
sam: working on docs, should have attestation draft today.
derek: I'll wire the runbook into the launch checklist and tag on-call.
staging-bot: deploy:staging to prod-sim environment started by raj at 2026-03-29T09:03:12Z :rocket:
leah: thanks everyone — we'll reconvene 03-30 10:00 UTC if any blockers remain. :thumbsup:
